title: Verify track.objects #33 0.2.0 STABLE-IDENTITY tracker (Phase C video spine, position 20)
intro: Run the run_module item locally through Invoke-Skill.ps1 (or the Module Launcher). Skill 0.2.0 makes the frontier-reviewed STABLE tracker the default (-Mode stable): scene-bounded, elapsed-TIME-aged, globally-assigned, with a tightly-gated centroid fallback, fixed-point arithmetic and a CANONICAL tracks.json (sorted keys, compact, integers, one trailing LF) split from diagnostics. The committed fixture is the review's 'moderate gap' probe case: an object detected at 0 and 500 ms, MISSED for two samples (1000/1500 ms), reappearing at 2000 ms displaced 42 px (zero IoU). The stable tracker must keep ONE identity by re-linking through the time-grown centroid allowance and record the gap as a first-class record -- the exact case the retired greedy default fragments on. Deterministic + parallel_safe (no model/CUDA/port); re-running yields a byte-identical tracks.json.

items.title: track.objects -Mode stable re-links the moderate-gap fixture into ONE track with a gap record
items.expected: status ok; artifacts tracks.json (canonical), diagnostics.json, tracks.md. The canonical doc (result.canonical): schema lifeorch.track.objects/0.2; samples[] lists ALL 6 processed samples (two with detection_count 0); summary.track_count == 1 with iou_link_total 2 + centroid_link_total 1; track 0 has observation_count 4 (never a fabricated coast box), gap_count 1 with gaps[0] = {missed_samples: 2, elapsed_ms: 1500, reacquired_by: 'centroid', start_ms: 500, end_ms: 2000}, association_summary.reacquisition_count 1, termination.reason 'end_of_input'. Re-running produces the same canonical_sha256. (-Mode greedy on the same fixture fragments into 2 tracks -- the retired baseline's failure this wave fixed.)

checklist.text: samples[] has 6 entries; sample_index 2 and 3 have detection_count 0
track 0: observation_count == 4, gap_count == 1, gaps[0].reacquired_by == 'centroid', gaps[0].missed_samples == 2, gaps[0].elapsed_ms == 1500
termination.reason == 'end_of_input'; no aggregate 'confidence' field anywhere in the canonical doc

checklist: re-running the same input yields the same result.canonical_sha256 (byte-identical canonical tracks.json)

items.title: Confirm the canonical/diagnostics split + cross-run determinism by inspection
items.action_text: Open the produced tracks.json: ONE line of compact JSON, first key 'algorithm', keys sorted, integers only (boxes are milli-pixels, scores are millionths, times are ms), and NO invocation id / absolute path / wall-clock anywhere in it -- those live in diagnostics.json. Run the item twice and compare the two tracks.json sha256 (must match). Optionally run with "mode":"greedy" and confirm it fragments the same fixture into 2 tracks (the baseline's moderate-gap failure).
items.expected: Canonical bytes: sorted keys, compact, all-integer, one trailing LF, volatile-free; two runs -> identical sha256. Manifest: version 0.2.0, parallel_safe true, gpu none, models [], network false.
checklist: tracks.json is one compact line starting {"algorithm":"stable-geometric-association/1"
no invocation_id / absolute path / timestamp-of-run appears in tracks.json (they are in diagnostics.json)
two runs produce byte-identical tracks.json (same sha256)
